name: Engineer
ability: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
wakes: Each night until the ability is used.
interaction: Declines, or points at a Demon or at Minions (as many as the Minion count). Changed evil players are woken and shown their new character. The Engineer is not told the result.
drunk_or_poisoned: Not addressed on the wiki; presumably the choice has no effect and the ability is spent.

jinxes.text: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Engineer starts knowing this but has no ability.

rulings.text: Choose Minions or a Demon, not both. The Demon player stays the Demon, Minions stay Minions; the evil count is unchanged.
Wrong number of choices: the Storyteller adjusts as fairly as possible; only script characters may be chosen.
Bracketed setup changes (e.g. Baron) do not apply mid-game; Outsiders already added stay.
The Storyteller decides which Minion player becomes which chosen Minion; Minions already matching keep their character.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: change-demon
test_scenarios.expected: The Imp player becomes the Lleech and is shown it; the Engineer has no ability.

test_scenarios.name: baron-to-boomdandy
test_scenarios.expected: The Baron player becomes the Boomdandy; the extra Outsiders remain.

test_scenarios.name: partial-match
test_scenarios.expected: The Witch becomes the Mezepheles; others unchanged.

test_scenarios.name: legion-jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Legion in play with the Engineer.
test_scenarios.expected: The Engineer learns Legion is in play and has no ability.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned-engineer
test_scenarios.setup: Engineer poisoned by the Poisoner; Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing changes; the ability is spent.
